title: Convert to Progressive Web App (PWA)

requirements.text: Add a Web App Manifest (manifest.json) to frontend/public with appropriate metadata including name, short_name, description, theme_color, background_color, display mode set to 'standalone', start_url, and icons array with multiple sizes (192x192, 512x512)
acceptanceCriteria: manifest.json exists in frontend/public directory
Manifest includes all required PWA fields
Display mode is set to 'standalone' for app-like experience
Icons array includes at least 192x192 and 512x512 sizes

requirements.text: Link the Web App Manifest in frontend/index.html using a link tag with rel='manifest' pointing to /manifest.json
acceptanceCriteria: Link tag for manifest is present in the head section of index.html
Manifest link uses correct path to manifest.json

requirements.text: Create a service worker file (sw.js) in frontend/public that implements basic caching strategies for offline functionality including cache-first for static assets and network-first for API calls
acceptanceCriteria: Service worker file exists at frontend/public/sw.js
Service worker implements caching for static assets
Service worker handles offline scenarios gracefully
Service worker uses appropriate cache strategies for different resource types

requirements.text: Register the service worker in frontend/src/main.tsx after the React app renders, with proper error handling and browser support detection
acceptanceCriteria: Service worker registration code is added to main.tsx
Registration includes browser compatibility check
Error handling is implemented for registration failures
Registration occurs after React app initialization

requirements.text: Add theme-color meta tag to frontend/index.html that matches the application's primary color scheme for consistent browser chrome styling
acceptanceCriteria: Theme-color meta tag is present in index.html head section
Color value matches the application's design system primary color

requirements.text: Generate PWA icon images in multiple sizes (at minimum 192x192 and 512x512) with a design that represents the application identity, saved to frontend/public/assets/generated
acceptanceCriteria: Icon files are generated in frontend/public/assets/generated directory
At least two icon sizes are provided: 192x192 and 512x512
Icons have transparent or appropriate backgrounds
Icons are referenced correctly in manifest.json

constraints: Must work within Internet Computer web platform constraints
Cannot use React Native or native mobile frameworks
Must maintain existing React + TypeScript + Tailwind stack
Service worker must not interfere with Internet Computer canister calls
nonGoals: Native device API access beyond web standards

required: PWA app icon with modern design representing a civic platform, suitable for transparent background (pwa-icon.dim_192x192.png)
PWA app icon with modern design representing a civic platform, suitable for transparent background, larger size (pwa-icon.dim_512x512.png)
